player_prompt.intro:
Agkalawen kayo {color} ed sakey a palaro na Breakthrough. Gumalaw kayo {direction} ed sakey a tabla na {board_size}x{board_size}.
Diad say turn yo, saray kayo a gumalaw na sakey a piraso ed abante o ed diagonally abante.
Say piraso so kagalaw la ed diagonally no adda piraso na kalaban ed saman, tan kagalaw la ed sakey a square a preoccupied ed sakey a diagonal step.
No agkalawen yo ed sakey a square a adda piraso na kalaban, kayo so makakapit ed saman tan say piraso na kalaban so matatanggalan la ed tabla.
Usaren yo sakey a notation a UCI-like ed bracket, e.g. [a2a3] a pangalawen ed a2 ed a3.
* 'a' so correspond ed say kolum na kawigi, '1' so row na babo (manlapit ed perspektibo na White).
* Say home row na Black so row na dapo (row 8 para ed sakey a 8x8). Say home row na White so row na babo (row 1 para ed sakey a 8x8).
Say unaan a player a say piraso so makakarating ed home row na kalaban so manalo. No say piraso yo so amin a makakapit, kayo so talo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mangusar kayo na algebraic notation ya walad bracket a singa say [a2a3].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Say gawa ed labas na laman na tabla.
invalid_move.illegal: Satan ya iyalis et agmanunor ed saray totontonen na Breakthrough odino aliwan satan so armas mo.

outcome.white_reached: Say puti et nakarating ed harong na reng itim.
outcome.black_reached: Akasabi so andeket ed home row na saray amputin.
outcome.white_captured: Amin a piga na saray Puti et adakep.
outcome.black_captured: Amin ya andeket a piraso so adakep.
outcome.no_moves: Anggapo lay nagawaan na {player_id} a manlalako.
